name: search
description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: A circular ring uses a true circular counter; the separately authored rounded capsule handle joins the solid ring. Fill overlap creates one silhouette with no doubled strokes. Combined visible bounds are approximately x/y=2.45..21.55. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Not owner-approved.
